function: Joint ISAC transmit beamforming (radar and communication precoders minimizing the CRB under an SINR constraint) and computation offloading, output by DNN policies (pp. 4, 5, 8).
system: Multi-user ISAC base station, 24 transmit antennas (uniform linear array), 5 terminals, Pmax 0.5 W, no RIS, frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 8).
method: Multi-task DNN with shared and task-specific layers, primal-dual (Lagrangian) training without labels, MGDA and low-complexity MGDA-UB; FedAvg-style federated framework described (pp. 3, 5-8).
data_channel: Custom simulation: the channel matrix H_k[t] has no stated distribution, trained on mini-batches of random channel states; no standard model or dataset (pp. 3, 8-9).
test_conditions: One simulated setting (K = 5, M = 24); curves over iterations plus sweeps of antennas, T_max and targets; no separate test condition stated (pp. 8-10).
baselines: Non-learned: zero-forcing beamforming, weighted-sum MSE minimization [37], reference method of [4]; learned: only the single-objective "unsupervised learning" variant of the same DNN, MGDA vs MGDA-UB (pp. 9-10, Figs. 6-10).
metrics: Sensing MSE, beampattern, spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz), power consumption (J), convergence over iterations (pp. 8-10, Figs. 4-11).
complexity: Order of complexity: O(INTL) for MGDA (Algorithm 1) and O(INT) for MGDA-UB (Algorithm 2), Table I (p. 8).
openness: None: only "python v3.10 and torch v2.0" is stated, with no code or data link (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 3: "represents channel matrix"; the channel H_k[t] is a generic matrix and Table II (p. 8) lists no channel model, so no standardized or measured channel is stated.
q2_support: p. 10: "The number of antennas ranges in [8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28]" is a sweep of the system size; the paper never states that a trained model is tested on a scenario, antenna number or user number unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 9: "The unsupervised learning method only insiders problem (32) without optimization of problem (31)"; the learned comparison is the same DNN trained on one objective, a variant of the proposed method, while zero-forcing, weighted-sum MSE minimization [37] and reference [4] are non-learned.
q4_support: p. 8: "Thus, the computational complexity is O (IN T L)" for Algorithm 1, and O (IN T ) for Algorithm 2 (Table I).
q5_support: p. 8: "The deployment is executed in python v3.10 and torch v2.0"; no code or data link is given and the channels are simulated, with no public dataset.
notes: Included under area 5: the DNN policies output the ISAC beamformers W = [w_r, w_c] (CRB objective under SINR and power constraints) jointly with the computation offloading F (p. 8: "The policy 1 π1 and policy 2 π2 takes charge of beamforming W = [wr, wc] and computation offloading F = [fl, fe]"), so a physical-layer decision is learned jointly with one above it and the above_phy exclusion does not apply. The federated learning is FedAvg with aggregation at the edge server (p. 3) and no over-the-air computation is used, so area 7 does not apply. q3 is 0 because the only learned comparison curve, Unsupervised Learning (Figs. 8-10, pp. 9-10), is the same DNN trained on one of the two objectives, a variant of the proposed method; the non-learned baselines are zero-forcing beamforming (Figs. 6-7), weighted-sum MSE minimization [37] (Fig. 8) and the reference method of [4] (Figs. 9-10, legend only). The reviewer should confirm this reading of q3. The channel model of H_k[t] is never defined (q1 = 0). Small inconsistencies (antenna range 8-28 in the text against 10-60 on the Fig. 9 axis; learning-rate captions of Figs. 4-5 swapped relative to the text on p. 8) do not change any mark.
